name: Arcanus Online
storyline: In a world fractured by ancient wars and forgotten magic, Arcanus is a land struggling to rebuild its kingdoms while dark forces gather in the shadows. As a new adventurer, you are drawn into an age-old conflict between light and darkness. Discover lost ruins, uncover legendary artifacts, and fight mythical creatures as you rise from a humble citizen to a hero of legend. Every decision you make will shape your destiny in this ever-evolving world of magic, mystery, and medieval intrigue.
summary: Arcanus Online is a 2D medieval fantasy MMORPG with pixel art aesthetics, where players can explore vast lands, battle monsters, complete quests, and interact with others in a classic retro-style online world. Developed in Visual Basic 6 with DirectX 7, the game preserves the nostalgic feel of early 2000s MMOs while offering a persistent online universe. Players can customize their characters, craft items, join guilds, and participate in real-time PvP and PvE adventures.
